gameDescriptionHtml:
Pure Bubble Hockey: Relive the Classic Arcade Thrill! Step into the nostalgic world of tabletop hockey with Pure Bubble Hockey, a meticulously crafted digital recreation of the beloved arcade classic. Experience the fast-paced, exhilarating action of bubble hockey right from the comfort of your own home, with a plethora of features designed to cater to both seasoned veterans and newcomers alike.

Classic Gameplay, Modern Customization – Dive into the familiar, addictive gameplay that made bubble hockey a staple of arcades and family game rooms. Control your team with precision and skill, aiming to outmaneuver your opponent and score that winning goal. But Pure Bubble Hockey isn’t just a faithful recreation; it elevates the experience with a wealth of customization options.

Game Features

  • Authentic bubble hockey gameplay.
  • Extensive team and game customization options.
  • Exciting game modes including Ice and Electric modes.
  • Classic organ music and realistic hockey sound effects.
  • Dynamic goal and end-of-period animations.
  • Solo and local co-op modes.
  • Mouse and keyboard and gamepad support.
  • Four unique and immersive arenas.
